eval12@01cfbb1e713f-e2ae5e3b8f: WITH g AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS S FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON CAST(a.player_id AS TEXT) = CAST(p.player_id AS TEXT) GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), t AS (SELECT AVG(S) AS T FROM g WHERE S IS NOT NULL) SELECT SUM(g.S) AS total_S, AVG(g.S - t.T) AS avg_diff FROM g JOIN t ON t.T IS NOT NULL WHERE g.S > t.T
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-5afc1a8b5c: SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS ratio FROM film_actor fa JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.rating HAVING SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () IS NOT NULL
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-6c1b7822e6: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.order_id, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS A FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), b AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM per_order) SELECT p.order_id, p.A, p.A - b.B AS diff FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.B IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.A - b.B) IS NULL, p.A - b.B DESC, p.order_id LIMIT 10
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-6ec8137fd3: WITH g AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), t AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS P, AVG(avg_ratio) AS R FROM g GROUP BY town_city), q AS (SELECT AVG(P) AS Q FROM t) SELECT t.town_city, t.P, t.R AS avg_cost_to_total_ratio, t.P - q.Q AS P_minus_Q FROM t JOIN q ON q.Q IS NOT NULL WHERE t.P > q.Q
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-b9ceda40df: SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS ratio FROM "order" WHERE k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(k_symbol) <> '' GROUP BY k_symbol ORDER BY k_symbol
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-3e50c13e8f: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS overall_avg FROM per_patient) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_patient p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_ana IS NOT NULL AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ana > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC, p.ID LIMIT 10
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-227771660b: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS a3, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS a4 FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), per_sex AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(a3) AS s3, AVG(a4) AS s4 FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(s3) AS M FROM per_sex), kept AS (SELECT s.SEX, s.s3, s.s4, s.s3 - m.M AS diff FROM per_sex s, m WHERE s.s3 > m.M) SELECT AVG(s3) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(s4) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM kept
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-40a0836cfa: WITH c AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS T FROM c), r AS (SELECT c.ID, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.T AS R FROM c CROSS JOIN t), m AS (SELECT AVG(R) AS M FROM r) SELECT r.ID, r.cnt AS exam_count, r.R, r.R - m.M AS diff FROM r INNER JOIN m ON m.M IS NOT NULL WHERE r.R > m.M ORDER BY (r.R - m.M) IS NULL, (r.R - m.M) DESC LIMIT 10
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-b3691a7c41: WITH c AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS T FROM c), r AS (SELECT c.ID, c.cnt, c.cnt*1.0/t.T AS ratio FROM c, t), m AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS M FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(r.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(r.ratio - m.M) AS avg_difference FROM r JOIN m ON r.ratio > m.M
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-c759056a31: WITH g AS (SELECT cs.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY cs.raceId, c.country), ctry AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_points) AS A, AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_avg_wins FROM g GROUP BY country), b AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM ctry) SELECT ctry.country, ctry.A AS avg_avg_points, ctry.avg_avg_wins, ctry.A - b.B AS diff_from_overall FROM ctry JOIN b ON b.B IS NOT NULL
eval12@01cfbb1e713f-5f1a57a3d8: WITH g AS (SELECT ordervault, COUNT(*) AS c FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault), t AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS T FROM g), r AS (SELECT g.ordervault, g.c, CAST(g.c AS REAL)/t.T AS R FROM g JOIN t ON t.T IS NOT NULL), y AS (SELECT AVG(R) AS Y FROM r) SELECT SUM(r.c) AS total_count, AVG(r.R) AS avg_R, AVG(r.R - y.Y) AS avg_D FROM r JOIN y ON y.Y IS NOT NULL WHERE r.R > y.Y
